title: Transiciones entre lugares
description: The game opens out of the dark, and going through a door or up a stair, and wherever the story takes the party, the screen goes dark, the place changes under it and it clears (game.ts `travel`, story-ui.ts `veil` and `open`). Each door here is used with the key, as a player does; the shots catch the picture darkening, the dark, and the new place coming in. Run it with --gpu so the timings hold.

steps.caption: The game opens in the dark while the saved place is put up (story-ui.ts `open`)
…and comes out of it where the save left Gerard: no jump from the default place
The flat on the Meridiana, at its door
The key pressed: the flat darkens
The street is already there under the dark, and comes in
Chapter 1: the entrance of the house, by the door to the hall
Into the house: the same dark between rooms
